description: Update the desktop client’s cloud settings (hotkeys, overlay style, modes, auto-answer, silence gate, disguise, theme…). Pass only what changes; overlayStyle, actionHotkeys and disguise are merged by key. Current values via get_settings. The client applies cloud settings on its next launch or sign-in; if the user changes any setting locally before that, the local copy wins. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)

actionHotkeys.description: Overlay action hotkeys, merged by key; values are Tauri accelerators such as CommandOrControl+Shift+Enter. Actions: answer capture voice-ask scroll-up scroll-down move-left move-right move-up move-down copy-code size-up size-down opacity-up opacity-down text-opacity-up text-opacity-down auto-palette restore-palette

audioSource.description: Interview type: SPEAKER online (system audio) / PHONE phone interview (microphone)

autoAnswer.description: Answer automatically when the interviewer finishes; when off, only on “Answer now”

disguise.description: Custom process name and window title, merged by key

hotkeyScheme.description: Default hotkey scheme for actions not set individually: simple / conflict-free

locale.description: UI language; null follows the system

overlayStyle.description: Overlay style, merged by key: theme, interviewBgOpacity / examBgOpacity (0–1), interviewTextOpacity / examTextOpacity (0–1), interviewBorderOpacity / examBorderOpacity, fontScale (0.3–4), textBold, textHalo, scrollSpeed (0.05–5), hotkeyOpacityStep, examSolveHoverMs, interviewWidth / interviewHeight / examWidth / examHeight (pixels)

silenceGateMs.description: How long the interviewer must pause before the question counts as finished (ms, 300–6000)

solverExamMode.description: Mode for screenshot answers during interviews: instant / quick / programming

name: update_client_settings
